newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow region to get credit rating June - official.
newsitem.headline: Moscow region to get credit rating June - official.

text.p: The Moscow region, which plans to issue up to $400 million worth of Eurobonds, will get a credit rating in June, an official with Unikombank, the adviser on the issue, said on Monday.
Previously the bank said the region would get a credit rating from Moody's and IBCA in May.
"Our expectations of getting a rating in May were over-optimistic," chief economist Andrei Baturkin told Reuters. "Now we expect it in June. The volume of the issue will mainly depend on the rating."
Last week the City of Moscow -- a different entity to the region -- placed a $500 million three-year Eurobond with a spread of 315 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
